name: Hegic(old contract)
rootCause: On March 1, 2025, Hegic's old options contract on Ethereum was exploited due to a withdrawal logic flaw, allowing an attacker to repeatedly drain funds from the same tranche. Losses are estimated at around $80,000. The withdrawWithoutHedge() function and its internal _withdraw() handler did not enforce or update the tranche's Open/Closed state correctly. This flaw let an attacker repeatedly withdraw from a single eligible tranche, extracting value multiple times instead of once.
